content: If someone is able to show me that what I think or do is not right, I will happily change, for I seek the truth, by which no one was ever truly hurt.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
Written in military campaign tents along the freezing Danube River during the Marcomannic Wars (170–180 CE), Marcus wrestled with the Antonine Plague, the betrayal of General Avidius Cassius, and the crushing responsibilities of the Roman Empire. In his private journal, he strictly commanded himself to master his judgments, embrace cosmic duty, and remain uncorrupted by imperial power.

In formulating this reflection, Marcus Aurelius stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of truth. For Marcus Aurelius, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
